title: parse
summary: parse.rs is Benilla's opcode-to-parser dispatch. MSUI's counterpart is the GameLoop.Net switch plus NetworkClient pre-world handling. The pre-pass contained many false negatives now corrected, including the complete cooldown follow-up family, movement modes, mirror timers, group loot, emotes, weather/sound, group administration, world states, minimap ping, raid targets/ready checks, and channel notifications. Remaining gaps are tracked explicitly below rather than by the stale original recount.

openItems.text: Spline/relay observer speed families remain unhandled: SMSG_SPLINE_SET_* (6), MSG_MOVE_SET_*_SPEED relays (6). The six SMSG_FORCE_*_SPEED_CHANGE controller packets are implemented.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: MovementRelayPackets covers the exact 21 [packed guid][MovementInfo] relays. MovementSpeedPackets covers all six [packed guid][f32] SPLINE_SET bodies and all six [packed guid][MovementInfo][f32] MOVE_SET bodies with finite nonnegative speeds and strict exhaustion; GameLoop.Net dispatches all three families.

openItems.text: Move modes unhandled: SMSG_MOVE_WATER_WALK/LAND_WALK, FEATHER_FALL/NORMAL_FALL, SET_HOVER/UNSET_HOVER
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The six non-root movement-mode SMSGs and root/unroot share strict packed-guid/u32-counter decoding through MovementModePackets.
2026-08-21: all three strict mirror-timer bodies are dispatched to the server-rate integrated bar state.

2026-08-22: DuelPackets strictly parses all six inbound shapes and GameLoop.Net dispatches request, bounds, completion, winner, and countdown state; DuelFrame clinical checks pin opcodes, bodies, state, and wiring.
2026-08-21: all four strict group-loot packet shapes are dispatched through LootPackets and covered by focused goldens.

openItems.text: Cooldown extras unhandled: SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN, SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT, SMSG_ITEM_COOLDOWN, SMSG_COOLDOWN_CHEAT
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: all four strict cooldown follow-up shapes are decoded and dispatched through CooldownPackets to addressed player/pet state; the focused cooldown protocol suite pins bytes and state transitions.

openItems.text: SMSG_EMOTE remains unhandled. SMSG_TEXT_EMOTE and SMSG_AI_REACTION are decoded and dispatched.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: SMSG_EMOTE now strict-parses u32 Emotes.dbc id + raw u64 guid, resolves AnimationData/EventSoundID, applies the reference sleep/swim/channel/combat receive gate, and routes the one-shot to local or streamed bodies. SMSG_TEXT_EMOTE and SMSG_AI_REACTION were already covered.

openItems.text: SMSG_COMPRESSED_MOVES remains unhandled. SMSG_WEATHER and SMSG_PLAY_SOUND/MUSIC/OBJECT_SOUND now use exact strict decoders and world-audio dispatch.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: CompressedMovementPackets inflates the zlib envelope, walks exact [u8 size][u16 opcode][body] records with size including opcode, rejects undersized/truncated/nested/foreign records, and sends each strict-decoded MSG_MOVE_* relay through the same remote-player observer path in original order. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify a crowded nearby-player scene where realmd emits SMSG_COMPRESSED_MOVES: every contained relay should apply in order with no skipped batch, pose snap, self correction, or stalled observer animation.

The remaining misc parse gap is SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS. SMSG_CHANNEL_LIST is now strict-decoded and dispatched, alongside SET_PROFICIENCY, transfer-aborted, exploration-experience, pet-name response, login time-speed, item-enchant-time, mount-special, played-time, random-roll, area-trigger, durability-death, inventory-change-failure, mount/dismount-result, new-taxi-path, spirit-healer, chat-error, and corpse-query events.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: SpellLifecyclePacketParser now byte-exactly parses [raw u64 caster][u32 spell][u32 count][count * raw u64 targets], rejects truncated and trailing data without count-sized hostile allocation, and GameLoop.Net dispatches opcode 0x0330.
